blocks.text: Vascular bimariyan dimagh aur spinal cord ki khoon ki nalyon ko mutasir karti hain; misalein stroke aur cerebral venous thrombosis hain.

blocks.caption: Stroke
rows: dimagh ke cells ka nuqsan jab band ya phati nali ki wajah se dimagh ke kisi hisse ki khoon ki supply ruk jaye
high blood pressure, tambakoo noshi, ziabetes, zyada cholesterol, motapa, khandan mein stroke

mutasir hisse par munhasir: cerebral infarction (murda tissue) ki mukhalif taraf falij; aphasia (alfaz mein baat na kar sakna); achanak dekhne ya chalne mein mushkil; chakkar, tawazun ka khatam hona; shadeed sar dard

jitna jald ho sake: dawayein (khoon patla karne wali, lothra ghulane wali, high blood pressure ki); lothra nikalne ya phati nali theek karne ki surgery; jismani aur zehni salahiyat wapas lane ke liye bahali (rehabilitation)

items: Ischaemic stroke: dimagh ki khoon ki nalyan tang ya band ho jati hain.
Haemorrhagic stroke: dimagh ki koi nali risti ya phat jati hai.
Transient ischaemic attack (mini-stroke): dimagh ke kisi hisse ki khoon ki supply mein aarzi kami, jo paanch minute tak bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Dimagh ke do khaake. Ischaemic stroke: surkh artery jise gehra lothra band kar raha hai, aur us ke aage dashed surmai hissa jo khoon se mehroom hai. Haemorrhagic stroke: artery jis se surkh khoon dimagh mein ris raha hai. Note transient ischaemic attack batata hai, khoon ki supply mein thori der ki kami jo paanch minute tak bhi ho sakti hai.
blocks.caption: Stroke ki bari qismein (Figure 15.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Stroke dimagh ke cells ka nuqsan hai jab dimagh ke kisi hisse ki khoon ki supply ruk jaye. Ischaemic stroke mein nali tang ya band hoti; haemorrhagic stroke mein nali risti ya phat jati hai; transient ischaemic attack (mini-stroke) supply mein aarzi kami hai. Wajahon mein high blood pressure, tambakoo noshi, ziabetes, zyada cholesterol, motapa aur khandani tareekh shamil hain. Falij nuqsan wale hisse ki mukhalif taraf ke jism par hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Baen cerebral hemisphere ka stroke jism ki kaunsi taraf falij karta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Daen taraf, kyunke har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf ko motor hukm bhejta hai.

items: Stroke: khoon ki supply ruk jana (ischaemic: band; haemorrhagic: phati; TIA: aarzi). Khatre: high blood pressure, tambakoo, ziabetes. Fauri ilaj: dawayein, surgery, bahali.
